chain_capabilities_needs_check.name: chain_capabilities_needs_check
chain_capabilities_needs_check.value: "chain_capabilities"."status" = 'planned' or ("chain_capabilities"."check_id" is not null and "chain_capabilities"."source" is not null)

provider_runs_block_range.name: provider_runs_block_range
provider_runs_block_range.value: "provider_runs"."block_from" is null or "provider_runs"."block_to" is null or "provider_runs"."block_from" <= "provider_runs"."block_to"

token_snapshots_pct_range.name: token_snapshots_pct_range
token_snapshots_pct_range.value:
("token_snapshots"."top10_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top10_pct" between 0 and 100)
        and ("token_snapshots"."top50_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top50_pct" between 0 and 100)

token_snapshots_top10_within_top50.name: token_snapshots_top10_within_top50
token_snapshots_top10_within_top50.value: "token_snapshots"."top10_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top50_pct" is null or "token_snapshots"."top10_pct" <= "token_snapshots"."top50_pct"

token_snapshots_counts_non_negative.name: token_snapshots_counts_non_negative
token_snapshots_counts_non_negative.value:
("token_snapshots"."holder_count" is null or "token_snapshots"."holder_count" >= 0)
        and ("token_snapshots"."tx_count_24h" is null or "token_snapshots"."tx_count_24h" >= 0)

evidence_fact_is_anchored.name: evidence_fact_is_anchored
evidence_fact_is_anchored.value: "evidence"."classification" <> 'verified_fact' or "evidence"."tx_hash" is not null or "evidence"."block_number" is not null

evidence_heuristic_is_explained.name: evidence_heuristic_is_explained
evidence_heuristic_is_explained.value: "evidence"."classification" <> 'heuristic' or ("evidence"."heuristic_name" is not null and "evidence"."confidence" is not null)

bridge_transfers_matched_is_explained.name: bridge_transfers_matched_is_explained
bridge_transfers_matched_is_explained.value: "bridge_transfers"."status" <> 'matched' or ("bridge_transfers"."dest_chain_id" is not null and "bridge_transfers"."match_heuristic" is not null and "bridge_transfers"."match_confidence" is not null and "bridge_transfers"."recipient_address_id" is not null and "bridge_transfers"."amount_received_raw" is not null and "bridge_transfers"."received_at" is not null)

multichain_chain_activity_unavailable_ha.name: multichain_chain_activity_unavailable_has_no_numbers
multichain_chain_activity_unavailable_ha.value: "multichain_chain_activity"."status" <> 'unavailable' or ("multichain_chain_activity"."tx_count" is null and "multichain_chain_activity"."in_usd" is null and "multichain_chain_activity"."out_usd" is null and "multichain_chain_activity"."counterparty_count" is null)

multichain_chain_activity_seen_order.name: multichain_chain_activity_seen_order
multichain_chain_activity_seen_order.value: "multichain_chain_activity"."first_seen_at" is null or "multichain_chain_activity"."last_seen_at" is null or "multichain_chain_activity"."first_seen_at" <= "multichain_chain_activity"."last_seen_at"

search_entities_label_has_source.name: search_entities_label_has_source
search_entities_label_has_source.value: ("search_entities"."label_type" is null) = ("search_entities"."label_source" is null) and ("search_entities"."label_source" is null) = ("search_entities"."label_source_name" is null)

case_subjects_address_needs_chain.name: case_subjects_address_needs_chain
case_subjects_address_needs_chain.value: "case_subjects"."address_id" is null or "case_subjects"."chain_id" is not null

risk_trait_checks_detected_is_backed.name: risk_trait_checks_detected_is_backed
risk_trait_checks_detected_is_backed.value: "risk_trait_checks"."status" <> 'detected' or "risk_trait_checks"."reason_id" is not null or "risk_trait_checks"."warning_id" is not null or "risk_trait_checks"."note" is not null

risk_trait_checks_reference_only_when_de.name: risk_trait_checks_reference_only_when_detected
risk_trait_checks_reference_only_when_de.value: "risk_trait_checks"."status" = 'detected' or ("risk_trait_checks"."reason_id" is null and "risk_trait_checks"."warning_id" is null)
